title: Overview of the HASOC Subtrack at FIRE 2021: Hate Speech and Offensive Content Identification in English and Indo-Aryan Languages
reasoning: The paper provides an overview of a shared task for hate speech and offensive language identification. While the dataset include categories such as 'islamophobia', the study is technical in nature, focusing on classification performance and data collection methodologies rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious beliefs, morals, or ethical systems themselves.
